body: Trend lens: ang importanteng pattern dito ay hindi lang 'may bagong scam,' kundi exploitation after an earlier loss — recovery itself becomes the bait. Hindi pa sapat ang isang CAA warning para sabihing accelerating nationwide trend, so huwag muna tayong gumawa ng conspiracy corkboard. Ang confirmation signal: repeated official alerts or consultation data showing the same second-stage recovery tactic growing over time. If that appears, prevention should target previous victims specifically, not just the general public.

claims.text: Repeated official alerts or consultation data showing growth in second-stage recovery tactics would strengthen the case that this is an emerging pattern rather than an isolated warning.
claims.basis: Conditional trend criterion; the current article documents the tactic but not a time-series growth rate
